title: Cate P
content: I became pregnant with my twin boys in November 2016. It was a difficult pregnancy, with labor starting at 30 weeks. The twins were eventually born on July 1, 2017, at 35 weeks and 2 days gestation. A week after the twins were born, I was feeling very unwell and, thinking I had mastitis, I went to the emergency room. The doctor arranged for an ultrasound, whereupon it was discovered that I had retained product of conception. A D&C was arranged and completed on July 10, 2017. The procedure went smoothly, and I was sent home from the hospital to recover. At home, I was relaxing and recovering when I stood up to get something. Immediately, blood began gushing from between my legs. I recall soaking through half a dozen towels before the paramedics arrived at my home about half an hour later. At the hospital, the doctors could not stop the bleeding. It continued into the next morning. I knew that I was dying; I could feel death creeping into my body. I knew intrinsically that my life was slipping away. I was so scared. I had a restless sleep that night, hoping that the medications and blood transfusions would do their job. They did not. In the morning, I was lying in my hospital bed and still felt this inescapable feeling of death. I asked my nurse, “Am I going to die?” She looked at me and said, “We are doing everything we can.” In that moment of realization that I might not live, I saw three halos hover above me. Three beautiful, bright halos. I knew at once that they were from God. I knew in that moment that I would live and that I would not die. The halos hovered above me for a few moments, then they zoomed away through the wall and disappeared. Since then, the light from these halos has been within me, their brightness lighting my path. Shortly thereafter, I was brought into the operating room for an emergency hysterectomy. While on the operating table, I was clinically dead and resuscitated with blood products. I recall hovering above my body, looking around the room, and then returning to my body. This was not uncommon for me because I had done this before, earlier in 2016 while in the operating room for a separate D&C. I knew it was not my time. Ever since that day, I have thirsted for spiritual knowledge. What was the meaning of the halos? Why three? Was it because of my Catholic background that I recognized them as being from God? This event changed the trajectory of my life. I can now see auras, feel energy, channel Spirit to heal, and hear people who have passed. I can see into the future and channel my guides, among other things. I am slowly developing this spiritual part of myself and using it to bring love, light, and connection to those around me.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes, Childbirth, Other (briefly specify), Actively dying, had spiritual experience, clinical death, revived
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: I clearly left my body and existed outside it
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal, I felt an unwavering, unexplainable, inexplicable love, warmth, clarity, and assurance.
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: No change to hearing, but I am now clairaudient.
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes, See previous page for this answer.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.What was your religion prior to your exp: Unaffiliated- Nothing in particular- Secular unaffiliated, I was raised Catholic but was leaning towards atheism. I had seen things when I was younger, such as a Mary statue crying in a church, or channeling angels, but I did not recognize the significance of these events.
elements.Did your experience include features con: Content that was entirely not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes, I changed from being an agnostic/atheist to a spiritualist.
elements.During your experience, did you gain spe: Yes, I was able to access the clairs after this experience.
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Yes, I would not die on that date. I would not go with the lights.
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes, How do you explain what makes the color green? We can add blue and yellow together, but what are blue and yellow? They are colors. But how do you describe blue and yellow to someone who is colorblind? It is probably impossible. The same is true for my experience. How do you put unconditional love into words? It is probably impossible.
elements.How accurately do you remember the exper: I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes, I have all the clairs.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real, It was confusing, but I thirsted for understanding. I also felt surrounded by love.
